spec.acquisition: 128 points at 2048Hz, actual ADC and spectral confirmation
spec.main_beam: 10mm wide steel/PZT bimorph, .15mm substrate and .12mm layers,4.65g tip mass
spec.aux_beam: 6mm wide, .10mm substrate/.08mm PZT layers,.14g tip mass
spec.circuit: Diode rectifier; auxiliary voltage can enter RC envelope detector; comparator can gate MCU; otherwise MCU polls at100ms. Installed auxiliary beam and RC loads participate in coupled ODE.
spec.primitive_cost: Additional beam has mechanical response and input loading; envelope has2nF capacitance,100kohm charge path,20Mohm bleed; no free constructed delivery bit.
spec.uncertainty: Effective beam lengths can differ from nominal dimensions by an unknown, stationary manufacturing/mounting factor; zero deviation is possible.

controls.main_length_mm: Main energy-harvesting beam nominal length, mm.
controls.aux_length_mm: Auxiliary trigger beam nominal length, mm.
controls.gate_V: Stored-supply voltage required to start MCU; brownout is 1.8 V.
controls.threshold_V: Trigger-envelope voltage required to wake; separate from stored supply.

spec.branch_costs: Existing converter branch additionally charges A/B/C/D idle power 0.5/180/2/0.5 microW and B envelope energy. Existing direct branch does not charge that extra term. Both retain comparator/reference, leakage and actual envelope loads. C adds 5 microJ per SAVE on either branch. D dissipates actual parallel-shunt power.
